question_text: A city engineer, Engineer Reyes, is tasked with evaluating bids for a road construction project. His cousin owns one of the bidding companies. Under RA 6713, what action best demonstrates commitment to public interest?

options.text: Engineer Reyes evaluates all bids fairly, believing his cousin's bid will be judged on merit.
Engineer Reyes discloses the relationship to his supervisor and recuses himself from the evaluation process.
Engineer Reyes asks his cousin to withdraw the bid to avoid any appearance of impropriety.
Engineer Reyes continues with the evaluation but documents that he was impartial.
